On the screen, you will see a box for choosing levels of difficulty. Choose Level 1 or Level 2
A right triangle will appear on the screen with 2 sides labeled. You will need to determine
the third side using the Pythagorean theorem.
For each correct answer, you’ll receive 10 points.
Once you calculate the answer for the missing side, click the answer box and type the
answer, rounded to the nearest whole number.
When you are ready to have your answer checked, click Check Answer. If you’ve entered
an incorrect answer, you can try again.
If you’ve entered the correct value, your score will be increased by 10 points.

Select a level of difficulty and then click New Triangle to continue the game.
